reviews.text: They don't take good care of your dogs!
DO NOT LEAVE YOUR DOGS IN THIS PLACE
WARNING!! My cousin's dog is in the hospital with severe pneumonia because he left him training here.

It's very sad to hear the dogs howling nonstop because they were left alone on the weekend without any supervision. You can hear them desperately scratching at their cages and barking nonstop. I wish someone could calm them down.

Excellent place! The staff's kindness and patience, the groomer's skill and experience, and the clean and welcoming atmosphere were all excellent. My dog ​​was super happy after his bath and haircut, and we'll be back soon for more! 💕 …

The dogs bark and whine all weekend long, all day long. It seems like they're left alone on weekends with no one to look after them. They make too much noise, and it becomes a nuisance for all the neighbors, as the noise keeps everyone awake. The best thing would be for them to accept responsibility and address the complaints, instead of claiming it's a smear campaign. There's evidence, audio recordings that were sent to them and completely ignored. And of course, the decibel levels are well above the legal limit, because even with the windows closed, the noise is still audible!
